1--[[


2  A small but representative Warcraft III Lua script: tables, closures,


3  methods, every loop kind, varargs and string building.


4]]


5local MAX_COUNTERS <const> = 8


6local counters = {}


7


8---@class Counter


9local Counter = { created = 0 }


10Counter.__index = Counter


11


12function Counter.new(start)


13    local self = setmetatable({ value = start or 0 }, Counter)


14    Counter.created = Counter.created + 1


15    return self


16end


17


18function Counter:bump(by)


19    self.value = self.value + (by or 1)


20    return self.value


21end


22


23local function isEven(n)


24    return n % 2 == 0


25end


26


27local function sum(...)


28    local total = 0


29    for _, v in ipairs({ ... }) do


30        total = total + v


31    end


32    return total


33end


34


35function InitCounters()


36    for i = 1, MAX_COUNTERS do


37        counters[i] = Counter.new(i * 2)


38    end


39    local i = 0


40    while true do


41        i = i + 1


42        if i > MAX_COUNTERS then


43            break


44        elseif isEven(i) then


45            counters[i]:bump(-1)


46        end


47    end


48    repeat


49        i = i - 1


50    until i <= 0


51    print(("total: %d"):format(sum(1, 2, 3)) .. " of " .. #counters)


52    TimerStart(CreateTimer(), 1.0, true, function()


53        DestroyTimer(GetExpiredTimer())


54    end)


55end
